key_concepts.formula: x percent means x hundredths, written as x%. x% = x/100.
Percentage Increase = (Increase / Original Value) × 100; Percentage Decrease = (Decrease / Original Value) × 100.
If price of a commodity increases by R%, reduction in consumption = [R / (100 + R)] × 100% to keep expenditure constant.
Population after n years = P(1 + R/100)^n; Machine value after n years = V(1 − R/100)^n.
